recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future standard Encounter service-type search parameter should be handled as a separate explicit Patient Administration tracker rather than inferred from FHIR-25794.
issue_request: FHIR-25794 was a Published/Persuasive PA issue asking why Encounter.serviceType was 0..1 while comparable service type fields in Appointment and HealthcareService could repeat, and also asking whether Encounter should have a service-type search parameter. The final resolution approved updating Encounter.serviceType cardinality to 0..* for R5.
initial_application: Commit 636866f7f8b827d44e9455590965ec1f68c48810 explicitly applied FHIR-25794 by changing Encounter.serviceType max from 1 to * in source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml. Current source still shows min 0 and max * for Encounter.serviceType.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Encounter, Appointment, and HealthcareService. Appointment.serviceType and HealthcareService.type are repeating, matching the comparison in the request. The direct Zulip thread contains the same report and Brian Postlethwaite's statement that Appointment and Encounter should have the same cardinalities. PA WGM minutes record the persuasive vote and relate FHIR-25794 to FHIR-22485; FHIR-22485 later says the ServiceType property was already updated in R5 and history is covered by EncounterHistory. The current Encounter search-parameter bundle has no service-type parameter, but that was not included in FHIR-25794's final resolution and no final linked decision was found that requires adding it here.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative Encounter StructureDefinition already implements the approved cardinality, and adding a new search parameter would exceed the resolved scope of FHIR-25794.

related_jiras.note: Explicitly linked in PA minutes; its Applied resolution confirms the R5 Encounter.serviceType update was already done and handles history via EncounterHistory.
Later Resolved - change required issue about wording alignment for Encounter.serviceType; not Applied/Published in this default run and not needed for the cardinality audit.
